set.body:
Plan: docs/plans/2026-09-18-best-recall-to-video-mapper.md §3 Phase 2 Reliability belongs to the final decision.

A provider-score mapping does not certify a decoded anchor that the decoder moved. The preregistration bars a calibration claim based on one film.

Scope:
Define the assessed event, bind the reliability model to the whole pipeline, fit and assess it separately.

Acceptance criteria:
1. The assessed event is defined per task (correct scene, correct film, or a declared interval tolerance).
2. The reliability model is bound by hash to the scorer, candidate set, decoder, fill policy and support version; changing any of them invalidates it (test).
3. It is fit on a development calibration partition or participant-level out-of-fold predictions and assessed on data separate from its fit.
4. Held-out reliability and risk-coverage are reported with their corpus limits.
5. A dated study-log ledger entry (docs/plans/2026-09-02-recall-to-video-study-log.md) naming this read, its estimand and its participants is committed before the first gold read; the readout verifies the commit order.
6. No 'calibrated' claim is made from one film.

Gate (AGENTS.md SD2/SD6): `sbt -batch clean compileAll testAll` on the merge result, then
`sbt -batch scalafmtCheckAll scalafmtSbtCheck` as a separate run; every test task in build.sbt's
testAll alias reports bound totals (56 at 0e36a7fa, after the corpus modules were added; recount if
modules change); a named mutation witness per new guard, and each compile-time-probe mutation proved
after its own clean recompile; `cd docs-site && npm run verify:examples` when public API or examples
change; fresh-context cold review in a separate pass; the commit body states the evidence and what
it does not establish.

Size: M.
set.title: Phase 2: reliability contract for the final emitted decision
